motivation: Retain v11's vertically verified choice, but reopen the already-generated horizontal fast/accuracy/baseline frontier only when one draft is the unique strict winner on prompt-visible checks.

selection_rule.evidence: only doctests and assertions already present in the prompt
selection_rule.switch: switch away from v11 only when exactly one candidate passes strictly more visible checks than the v11 candidate

holdout.access: only after development promotion gate passes

cross_task_promotion: Only after the HumanEval development gate; then test MATH-50 and MBPP with their aligned evaluators.
formal_baseline: original LLaDA low-confidence, steps=128, gen_length=256, block_length=32, seed=0,1234,1234,1234
